resources.string: When enabled, WAEX retains manager crash types, screen names, changed setting keys (not values), and WhatsApp hook startup and failure summaries for the last 7 days (maximum 1.75 MiB of event files). At export, it adds device model, Android and app versions, memory, storage, battery, Boolean feature settings and WAEX process exit reasons. No chats, contacts, message IDs, media, passwords, raw logcat or WhatsApp crash stacks are collected. There is no background monitoring.
The report can reveal your device model and enabled WAEX feature flags. Review it before sharing. You choose Telegram, select the developer group and confirm Send; nothing is uploaded automatically.
